geometry_contract.definition: recording-specific candidate bearing; relative to anatomical body forward when 3-D skeleton geometry is available, otherwise the per-recording source-camera optical-axis yaw relative to C001
geometry_contract.fallback_definition: per-recording source camera forward-axis yaw relative to C001; not an estimate of human anatomical yaw
geometry_contract.missing_skeleton_fallback: per-recording CSV optical-axis relative yaw; confidence=0.35
